# `jouet graph symbols`

- **Usage:** `jouet graph symbols [FLAGS] [QUERY]`

Find symbols by name, qualified name or words

An exact name comes first, then a qualified name (`Client::push`, `Client.push`), then symbols whose name, docstring or signature has every word (`retry backoff`; `processPayment` has the words `process` and `payment`). With no QUERY, lists every symbol under --path. Each line is `path:line kind qualified-name`, and the ID after `#` names the symbol to other graph commands.

## Arguments
- **`[QUERY]`** — A name, a qualified name, or words

## Flags
- **`--kind <KIND>`** — Only symbols of this kind: function, method, class, struct, …
- **`--path <PATH>`** — Only symbols in this file or directory
- **`--budget <BYTES>`** — The most bytes to print (default 6000; 0 is no limit)
- **`--page <N>`** — Which page of a longer answer to print (default 1)
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
